verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Cognee publishes an llms.txt at docs.cognee.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the product for agents. Doc pages are also served as raw .md URLs, including an llms-integrations.md page, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt, and no independent or hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs.
